description_sq:
Penthouse ndodhet ne katin 12 te nje prej pallateve me cilesore te Tiranes, tek Ish cirku, ne Bulevardin Zogu i Pare.
Pallati disponon dy ashensore dhe zona mundeson nje jetese luksoze.
Zona dhe planimetria e apartamentit bejne te mundur shfrytezimin jo vetem per banim, por edhe per investim dhe ndarje ne disa apartamente me te vogla.
Eshte i organizuar ne:
Nje sallon i bollshem me akses ne verande
Nje kuzhine/ dhome ngrenie e vecuar
Nje verande me hapsire 35 metra dhe nje depo
Dy tualete
Tre dhoma gjumi
Dy koridore shperndarese
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion, apo nje vizite ne prone, mos nguronite kontaktoni!
title_en: PENTHOUSE FOR SALE IN THE CENTER!
description_en: The penthouse is located on the 12th floor of one of the highest quality buildings in Tirana, in the former circus, on Zogu i Pare Boulevard. The building has two elevators and the area allows for a luxurious lifestyle. The area and floor plan of the apartment make it possible to use it not only for living, but also for investment and sharing in some smaller apartments. It is organized in: A spacious living room with access to the veranda A separate kitchen/dining room A veranda with a space of 35 meters and a storage room Two toilets Three bedrooms Two distribution corridors The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
